create_MoCoHook: create a MoCoHook instance with a momentum coefficient and optional batch shuffling flag
build_moco_encoder: build a momentum encoder model that tracks the main model parameters during training
update_momentum_encoder: update the momentum encoder parameters as an exponential moving average of the base model
shuffle_batch_ddp: shuffle a batch across distributed GPUs to enable correct BatchNorm computation
run_on_forward: run the MoCo forward hook to update the momentum encoder and compute normalized key features
